steps.title: Keep a list in memory
steps.body: Create an array named tasks. It can start empty.

steps.title: Draw the list
steps.body: Find the ul with id list and write a function that turns the tasks array into li elements inside it.

steps.title: Add what you typed
steps.body: On a click of the button with id add, read the input with id task, store that text, and show it in the list.
